author_quote: Salve os 3 capítulos como cânone e não mais rascunho. E me traga as últimas 4 opções atualizadas pra continuarmos.
source_evidence: Varo estava corrigindo a posição de um legionário quando Caedren apareceu.
author_decision: Author approved all three literal episodes as canon. Therefore the D539 sentence showing Caedren at the Legião yard is part of the narrative. No journey, allegiance, orders, rank, or command succession can be inferred; the earlier D492 freedom and no-military-obligation statement remain valid.
semantic_risk: The narrative does not state how Caedren reached Três Arcos after his last historical appearance; future continuity must not invent travel as established fact.
